summary: Retested Market.jsx search-overrides-category bug from iteration_3. The claimed fix is NOT present in the code. The useMemo `shops` filter at /app/frontend/src/pages/Market.jsx line 92 still rejects items by category BEFORE checking the search needle, so searching 'DIGITAL' with the 'Moda' tab active does not surface an item without `categoria`. All 4 regression scenarios pass, but the primary HIGH bug still reproduces.

ui_bugs.issue: Search does NOT override the category filter. With 'Moda' active and query 'DIGITAL', item without categoria (bug-check-1 'DIGITAL GM') is still hidden. Expected: when needle!='' the category filter should be relaxed so any item whose text matches is shown regardless of its categoria (or missing categoria).

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Market.jsx, change the shops useMemo filter so that when needle is non-empty, the category filter is bypassed. Current logic (lines 91-101) always rejects items where x.categoria !== cat. Replace with something like: if (!needle && cat !== 'todos' && x.categoria !== cat) return false; — then evaluate needle match for all items. This matches the behavior described in the fix note.
critical_code_review_comments: Market.jsx line 92 contradicts the request's described fix. The code is identical in intent to the pre-fix version regarding search+category interaction.
Consider also searching in optional free-text fields consistently; current hay string looks fine.
seed_data_creation: localStorage.local_comercios seeded with 4 items (one without categoria, plus moda/deportes/hogar). Cleaned via overwrite only; left in localStorage after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary HIGH bug from iteration_3 still reproducible. Playwright flow: seed localStorage with item {id:'bug-check-1', nombre:'DIGITAL GM', _local:true} (no categoria), goto /market, dispatch utrerapp:local-updated event, click [data-testid='market-cat-moda'], fill [data-testid='market-search-input']='DIGITAL' → expect [data-testid='market-shop-bug-check-1'] visible. Currently shows 'Sin resultados'. Regressions 2-5 all pass.
rca of the issue: The useMemo in Market.jsx evaluates `if (cat !== 'todos' && x.categoria !== cat) return false;` unconditionally — i.e. before taking the search needle into account. The commit message claims this was relaxed when needle!='' but the file content shows it was not. Fix: gate that return by `!needle` or move the search match evaluation first and OR it with the category match.
